context: Naoko and her old friend Mrs. Mori meet at the public bath.
purpose: Two older women catching up at sento; warmly direct chat.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Oh, this hot water's absolutely lovely!
lines.style: Brassy, unguarded delight. Loud opening attack on the appreciation. Kansai warmth — unselfconscious, rolling through the words. No filter between feeling and voice.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Mm, brings you right back to life.
lines.style: Soft, knowing hum. Understated agreement — the nod of someone who's been coming to sentos for decades. Warm without performing. Trails gently at the end.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Gets you all warm inside and out.
lines.style: Animated, physical. Naoko luxuriating — voice follows the feeling through her body. Bright, almost childlike in its openness. Kansai lilt lifts on the second half.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 銭湯、また来ましょうね。
lines.en: We should come back again sometime.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, soft invite. Not pushing — just opening the door. The voice of someone content to let good moments be repeated without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええで、今度予定組もか!
lines.en: You're on — let's lock it in!
lines.style: Brassy, energetic follow-through. Loud Kansai certainty — she's already planning. Quick, eager grab onto the idea. No hesitation between suggestion and action.
